  for_project = ANY({{ projectSelector.value }})
  AND by_member = ANY({{ memberSelector.value }})
  AND (from_media_batch = ANY({{ mediaSelector.value }})

  AND tissue = ANY({{ tissueSelector.value }})
  AND technique = ANY({{ techniqueSelector.value }})
  AND CAST(date_created as DATE) >= CAST({{ dateRange.value.start }} as DATE)
  AND CAST(date_created as DATE) <= CAST({{ dateRange.value.end }} as DATE)
  AND (
  NULLIF({{ fridgeDateRange.value.start }}, '') IS NULL
  OR fridge_date > NULLIF({{ fridgeDateRange.value.start }}, '')::date
)
  AND (
  NULLIF({{ fridgeDateRange.value.end }}, '') IS NULL
  OR fridge_date < NULLIF({{ fridgeDateRange.value.end }}, '')::date
)
  AND (
  NULLIF({{ discardDateRange.value.start }}, '') IS NULL
  OR discard_date > NULLIF({{ discardDateRange.value.start }}, '')::date
)
  AND (
  NULLIF({{ discardDateRange.value.end }}, '') IS NULL
  OR discard_date < NULLIF({{ discardDateRange.value.end }}, '')::date
)
  AND incubation_temperature >= CAST({{ tempSelector.value.start }} AS integer)
  AND incubation_temperature <= CAST({{ tempSelector.value.end }} AS integer)
  AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM unnest({{ physicalLabelSearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
        WHERE physical_label LIKE '%' || term || '%'
      )
    )
  ) as big_query
  WHERE (
  comes_from = ANY({{ prospectiveSourceSearch.value }})
  OR (
    (comes_from IS NULL OR comes_from::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ prospectiveSourceSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
AND (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM unnest({{ notesSearch.value }}::text[]) AS term
    WHERE notes LIKE '%' || term || '%'
  )
  OR (
    (notes IS NULL OR notes::text = '')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM unnest({{ notesSearch.value }}::text[]) AS x(term)
      WHERE term IS NULL
    )
  )
)
  order by date_created desc, physical_label desc;
